name: diff-prefix-config
source: real change in the muellim repository: fix(git): pin a/ and b/ diff prefixes so the path filters match under any diff config

question.topic: diff prefixes and the ignore list
question.prompt: A user has diff.mnemonicPrefix = true in their global git config, and .muellimignore contains /secrets/. They change secrets/prod.yml. What did the old diffSince let through, and how do the new flags fix it?
question.answerKey: Under mnemonicPrefix git prints c/ and w/ instead of a/ and b/. parseDiff strips only a/ and b/, so the old code recorded w/secrets/prod.yml, the anchored /secrets/ pattern did not match, and the chunk went to the AI. --src-prefix=a/ and --dst-prefix=b/ make git print a/ and b/ whatever the config, so the path is secrets/prod.yml and the ignore rule drops it.
rubric: the user's config changed the prefixes, so the parsed path kept w/ and the anchored ignore pattern no longer matched, letting the ignored file reach the AI
the explicit --src-prefix=a/ and --dst-prefix=b/ restore the prefixes parseDiff strips, so the ignore rule matches again

answers.text: Old: git wrote w/secrets/prod.yml, parseDiff only strips a/ and b/, so the path kept w/ and /secrets/ did not match, and the file went to the AI. The new flags force a/ and b/ so the path is secrets/prod.yml and gets filtered.
mnemonic prefix gives c/ and w/ paths, the anchored ignore misses, so it leaks. forcing the src/dst prefix to a/ b/ makes the path clean again so it is ignored
Nothing changed; .muellimignore is applied before git runs, so the prefix never mattered.
The flags turn off colour so the diff can be parsed.
